# Schema reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm generate` from packages/schema/src/registry.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every file td2d reads or writes has a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). `td2d schema <name>` prints one,
`td2d schema --write <dir>` writes them all, and the same files are committed in `schemas/`.
Inputs reject unknown keys, so a misspelt setting is reported at its path.

| Document | Kind | Where it lives |
|---|---|---|
| [`project`](#project) | input | td2d.project.json |
| [`asset`](#asset) | input | assets/<id>/asset.json |
| [`material`](#material) | input | asset.json materials.<name> |
| [`component`](#component) | input | components/<name>.json |
| [`batch-manifest`](#batch-manifest) | input | any file, passed to td2d batch --manifest |
| [`palette`](#palette) | input | palettes/<name>.json |
| [`camera-preset`](#camera-preset) | input | presets/camera/<name>.json |
| [`rig-preset`](#rig-preset) | input | presets/rig/<name>.json |
| [`lighting-preset`](#lighting-preset) | input | presets/lighting/<name>.json |
| [`pixel-preset`](#pixel-preset) | input | presets/pixel/<name>.json |
| [`sheet-preset`](#sheet-preset) | input | presets/sheet/<name>.json |
| [`export-preset`](#export-preset) | input | presets/export/<name>.json |
| [`resolved-asset`](#resolved-asset) | output | td2d asset show <id> |
| [`manifest`](#manifest) | output | build/<id>/sheets/manifest.json |
| [`aseprite-sheet`](#aseprite-sheet) | output | build/<id>/sheets/<name>.json |
| [`aseprite-sheet-array`](#aseprite-sheet-array) | output | build/<id>/sheets/<name>.json |
| [`pixi-sheet`](#pixi-sheet) | output | build/<id>/sheets/<sheet>.pixi.json |
| [`phaser-atlas`](#phaser-atlas) | output | build/<id>/sheets/<name>.phaser.json |
| [`validation-report`](#validation-report) | output | build/<id>/validation.json |
| [`generation-record`](#generation-record) | output | build/<id>/generation.json |
| [`batch-report`](#batch-report) | output | build/batch-report.json |
| [`cli-envelope`](#cli-envelope) | output | stdout |
| [`progress-event`](#progress-event) | output | stderr |

## project

Project configuration. Read from `td2d.project.json`. Schema: [schemas/project.schema.json](../../schemas/project.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `name` | yes | Project name, shown in the viewer and in reports. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |
| `paths` |  | Project directories, relative to the project root. |
| `defaults` |  | Defaults applied to assets before their own settings. |
| `typeDefaults` |  | Defaults per asset type, applied after defaults. |
| `cache` |  | Cache settings. |

## asset

Asset definition. Read from `assets/<id>/asset.json`. Schema: [schemas/asset.schema.json](../../schemas/asset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `id` |  | Optional. When present it must equal the directory path under assets/. |
| `type` | yes | Asset category. Selects type defaults such as frame size. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |
| `tags` |  | Lowercase labels for finding assets, such as "wood" or "enemy". The viewer filters by them. |
| `frame` |  | Final sprite cell size in pixels. |
| `pixelsPerUnit` |  | Pixels per metre in the final sprite; the camera frustum width is frame.width / pixelsPerUnit. "auto" picks the largest whole number that fits the model in every direction with one pixel to spare, and records it in the manifest. |
| `camera` |  | Camera preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides. |
| `lighting` |  | Lighting preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides. |
| `directions` |  | Directions to render: a set name such as "d8", compass names, or custom yaws. |
| `mirror` |  | Directions produced by flipping another direction horizontally, as "target:source". |
| `render` |  | Render settings. |
| `pixel` |  | Pixel preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides. |
| `sheet` |  | Sheet preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides. |
| `export` |  | Export preset name, or an object with an optional preset and overrides. |
| `rig` |  | Rig preset name, or an object with an optional preset, scale and bone changes. A preset name in a later layer starts the rig again from that preset. |
| `materials` |  | Materials keyed by name. |
| `model` | yes | Declarative model built from parts. |
| `animation` |  | Animation clips and sampling rate. |
| `acceptance` |  | Asset-specific checks enforced by validate and generate. |

## material

Material, used inside asset materials maps. Read from `asset.json materials.<name>`. Schema: [schemas/material.schema.json](../../schemas/material.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |
| `color` | yes | Either a #rrggbb colour or a palette reference. |
| `shading` |  | toon: banded lighting. flat: unlit base colour. lambert: smooth diffuse lighting. |
| `bands` |  | Number of light bands for toon shading. Default 3. |
| `emissive` |  | Emissive colour added regardless of lighting. |
| `outline` |  | Whether render.lines may line this material. Default true. Turn it off for fine detail such as grain, stitching or strands, and for dark gaps. |
| `opacity` |  | Render opacity. The pixel stage thresholds alpha, so values below 1 produce a warning. |

## component

Reusable, parameterised group of parts. Read from `components/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/component.schema.json](../../schemas/component.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `name` | yes | Lowercase kebab-case name. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |
| `params` |  | Parameters the component takes, with types, defaults and limits. Use them as ${name} in parts. |
| `materials` |  | Default materials. Asset materials with the same name win. |
| `parts` | yes | Parts, validated after "${...}" placeholders are replaced. A placeholder can hold arithmetic: "${height / 2}". |

## batch-manifest

Assets for td2d batch, with per-asset overrides. Read from `any file, passed to td2d batch --manifest`. Schema: [schemas/batch-manifest.schema.json](../../schemas/batch-manifest.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |
| `assets` | yes | Assets to generate, in order, each with optional overrides. |
| `options` |  | Batch options; command-line flags take precedence. |

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |

## camera-preset

Camera preset. Read from `presets/camera/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/camera-preset.schema.json](../../schemas/camera-preset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `projection` | yes | Only orthographic projection is supported. |
| `pitch` | yes | Degrees above the horizon the camera looks down from. 30 gives 2:1 pixel lines at 45 degrees of yaw. |
| `yawOffset` | yes | Degrees added to every direction yaw. |
| `groundMargin` | yes | Pixels between the pivot (ground) line and the bottom edge of the frame. "auto" picks the smallest margin that keeps the footprint in front of the pivot inside the frame in every direction. |
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `name` | yes | Lowercase kebab-case name. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |

## rig-preset

Rig preset: a named bone hierarchy. Read from `presets/rig/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/rig-preset.schema.json](../../schemas/rig-preset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `name` | yes | Lowercase kebab-case name. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |
| `bones` | yes | Every bone with its parent, rest position, rotation and limits. Parents come first. |

## lighting-preset

Lighting preset. Read from `presets/lighting/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/lighting-preset.schema.json](../../schemas/lighting-preset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `space` | yes | camera: lights turn with the camera so every direction shades alike. world: lights stay fixed. |
| `lights` | yes | One to eight lights: directional, ambient or hemisphere. |
| `shadows` | yes | Hard shadow settings. Shadows are always unfiltered for reproducibility. |
| `groundShadow` |  | Draw the shadow the model casts on the ground (y = 0) into the sprite. |
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `name` | yes | Lowercase kebab-case name. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |

## pixel-preset

Pixel processing preset. Read from `presets/pixel/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/pixel-preset.schema.json](../../schemas/pixel-preset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `downscale` |  | Downscale filter from the supersampled render. Both use the share of the block that is covered for alpha. box averages the colours, which smooths shading but makes in-between colours; mode takes the most common colour, which keeps only rendered colours. |
| `alphaThreshold` |  | Pixels with alpha at or above this value become opaque; all others become transparent. |
| `bleed` |  | Give transparent pixels the nearest opaque colour so engines that filter textures do not show dark halos. |
| `posterize` |  | Quantise each colour channel to this many levels before palette mapping. |
| `palette` |  | none, fixed:<palette-name> or auto:<colour count>. |
| `paletteScope` |  | For auto palettes: one palette for the whole asset (stable), or one per clip. |
| `dither` |  | Ordered dither used while mapping to a palette. Position-based, so it does not crawl between frames. |
| `ditherStrength` |  | How far dithering may push a colour, from 0 to 1. |
| `outline` |  | none, or a one-colour outline drawn from the alpha mask. |
| `cleanup` |  | What to do with stray single pixels. |
| `passes` |  | Run these passes in this order instead of the default. It must start with downscale and include alphaThreshold. |
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `name` | yes | Lowercase kebab-case name. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |

## sheet-preset

Sprite sheet layout preset. Read from `presets/sheet/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/sheet-preset.schema.json](../../schemas/sheet-preset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `layout` |  | grid: one row per clip and direction, one column per frame. strips: a separate sheet for each clip and direction. packed: sprites packed tightly with the maxrects algorithm. |
| `order` |  | Sequence order. clip-direction groups the sequences of a clip together; direction-clip groups by direction. |
| `flow` |  | grid and strips: each clip and direction runs along a row (left to right) or down a column. |
| `split` |  | Make a separate sheet for each clip or each direction. Sheets also split when they would exceed maxSize. |
| `trim` |  | packed: cut each sprite to its opaque pixels. The offset is recorded so pivots stay correct. |
| `padding` |  | Transparent pixels between cells. |
| `extrude` |  | Pixels of edge duplication around each cell, for engines that filter textures. |
| `powerOfTwo` |  | Round sheet sizes up to powers of two. |
| `maxSize` |  | Largest sheet edge in pixels. Larger layouts split into numbered sheets. |
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Document schema version. Any 1.x.y version is accepted. |
| `name` | yes | Lowercase kebab-case name. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |

## export-preset

Export preset. Read from `presets/export/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/export-preset.schema.json](../../schemas/export-preset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|

| `name` | yes | Lowercase kebab-case name. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |

## resolved-asset

Asset after defaults and presets are applied. Written to `td2d asset show <id>`. Schema: [schemas/resolved-asset.schema.json](../../schemas/resolved-asset.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | Asset id. Equals the directory path under assets/. |
| `type` | yes | Asset category. Selects type defaults such as frame size. |
| `description` |  | Free-text note. Use this instead of comments. |
| `tags` | yes | The asset's tags. |
| `sourceFile` | yes | Asset definition path relative to the project root. |
| `frame` | yes | Final sprite cell size in pixels. |
| `pixelsPerUnit` | yes | Pixels per metre in the final sprite; the camera frustum width is frame.width / pixelsPerUnit. "auto" picks the largest whole number that fits the model in every direction with one pixel to spare, and records it in the manifest. |
| `camera` | yes | Camera after presets and overrides, with the ground margin resolved. |
| `lighting` | yes | Lighting after presets and overrides. |
| `directions` | yes | Every direction to render, with mirrors resolved. |
| `materials` | yes | Materials by name. A part with its own colour gets a variant named <material>~<part id>. |
| `model` | yes | Parts with components expanded and imports hashed. |
| `rig` | yes | Bones in parent-first order, or null for an unrigged asset. |
| `animation` | yes | Clips with their sample times; generator clips keep their settings. |
| `render` | yes | Supersampling factor, render backend and lines. |
| `pixel` | yes | Pixel settings after presets and overrides. |
| `paletteColors` | yes | The colours of a fixed palette, or null. |
| `sheet` | yes | Sheet settings after presets and overrides. |
| `export` | yes | Export settings after presets and overrides. |
| `acceptance` | yes | Asset-specific checks enforced by validate and generate. |

## manifest

Generated asset manifest. Written to `build/<id>/sheets/manifest.json`. Schema: [schemas/manifest.schema.json](../../schemas/manifest.schema.json); see also [manifest.md](manifest.md).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Version of this output format, 1.x.y. Readers accept any 1.x. |
| `generator` | yes | The program that wrote the file, and its version. |
| `assetId` | yes | Asset id. Equals the directory path under assets/. |
| `assetHash` | yes | Hash of the resolved asset: equal hashes mean identical settings and inputs. |
| `generatedAt` | yes | When the file was written, in ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `frame` | yes | Size of every sprite, in pixels. |
| `pivot` | yes | Where the model stands in each frame: x and y in pixels, and normalized from 0 to 1. Set sprite origins or anchors to it. |
| `pixelsPerUnit` | yes | Scale the sprites were drawn at: pixels per metre. |
| `camera` | yes | The camera the sprites were rendered with. |
| `directions` | yes | Each direction: its name, yaw, and the direction it was mirrored from, if any. |
| `palette` | yes | The palette mode and every colour the sprites may use. |
| `clips` | yes | Each clip: frames, frame rate, duration, and whether it loops or moves on purpose. |
| `sheets` | yes | Each sheet image with its size and layout. Packed sheets may have several pages. |
| `cells` | yes | Every sprite: its key, the sheet it is on, its rectangle and trim offset. Read positions from here, never by guessing. |
| `files` | yes | Files written for each export format, relative to the manifest. |
| `stages` | yes | Hash of each stage up to the sheet: equal hashes mean equal outputs. |
| `validation` | yes | Validation status and counts; the checks are in the report file it names. |

## aseprite-sheet

Aseprite JSON Hash sprite sheet data. Written to `build/<id>/sheets/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/aseprite-sheet.schema.json](../../schemas/aseprite-sheet.schema.json); see also [export-formats.md](export-formats.md#aseprite-json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | yes | Frames by name, in sheet order. |
| `meta` | yes | The sheet image and size, one frame tag per clip and direction, and a pivot slice. |

## aseprite-sheet-array

Aseprite JSON Array sprite sheet data (export.aseprite.variant "array"). Written to `build/<id>/sheets/<name>.json`. Schema: [schemas/aseprite-sheet-array.schema.json](../../schemas/aseprite-sheet-array.schema.json); see also [export-formats.md](export-formats.md#aseprite-json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | yes | Frames in sheet order, each with its filename. |
| `meta` | yes | The sheet image and size, one frame tag per clip and direction, and a pivot slice. |

## pixi-sheet

PixiJS spritesheet data. Written to `build/<id>/sheets/<sheet>.pixi.json`. Schema: [schemas/pixi-sheet.schema.json](../../schemas/pixi-sheet.schema.json); see also [export-formats.md](export-formats.md#pixi).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | yes | Frames by sprite key, such as walk/s/000. |
| `animations` | yes | Frame names of each clip and direction, as <clip>_<direction>. |
| `meta` | yes | The sheet image, its size, and the other sheets of a split atlas. |

## phaser-atlas

Phaser multi-atlas data with animation configs. Written to `build/<id>/sheets/<name>.phaser.json`. Schema: [schemas/phaser-atlas.schema.json](../../schemas/phaser-atlas.schema.json); see also [export-formats.md](export-formats.md#phaser-atlas).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `textures` | yes | One texture per sheet image, with its frames. |
| `animations` | yes | Animation configs for this.anims.create, one per clip and direction. |
| `meta` | yes | The program that wrote the atlas. |

## validation-report

Output validation results. Written to `build/<id>/validation.json`. Schema: [schemas/validation-report.schema.json](../../schemas/validation-report.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Version of this output format, 1.x.y. Readers accept any 1.x. |
| `generator` | yes | The program that wrote the file, and its version. |
| `assetId` | yes | Asset id. Equals the directory path under assets/. |
| `generatedAt` | yes | When the file was written, in ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `status` | yes | fail if any check failed, warn if any warned, else pass. |
| `checks` | yes | Every check, with the frames it is about. |

## generation-record

Record of one generation. Written to `build/<id>/generation.json`. Schema: [schemas/generation-record.schema.json](../../schemas/generation-record.schema.json).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Version of this output format, 1.x.y. Readers accept any 1.x. |
| `generator` | yes | The program that wrote the file, and its version. |
| `assetId` | yes | Asset id. Equals the directory path under assets/. |
| `assetHash` | yes | Hash of the resolved asset: equal hashes mean identical settings and inputs. |
| `startedAt` | yes | When the generation started, in ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `finishedAt` | yes | When it finished, in ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `durationMs` | yes | Wall time in milliseconds. |
| `status` | yes | ok, warn (finished with warnings) or failed. |
| `backend` | yes | The render backend and the exact renderer it used, or null when nothing rendered. |
| `stages` | yes | Every stage in order: its hash, whether it came from the cache, and its time. |
| `outputs` | yes | Every file written, with its SHA-256 and size. |
| `warnings` | yes | Warnings raised while generating. |
| `error` |  | A structured error. |

## batch-report

Batch run summary. Written to `build/batch-report.json`. Schema: [schemas/batch-report.schema.json](../../schemas/batch-report.schema.json); see also [batch-report.md](batch-report.md).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | Version of this output format, 1.x.y. Readers accept any 1.x. |
| `generator` | yes | The program that wrote the file, and its version. |
| `startedAt` | yes | When the batch started, in ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `finishedAt` | yes | When it finished, in ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `durationMs` | yes | Wall time in milliseconds. |
| `status` | yes | ok and warn: every asset succeeded. partial: some failed and the rest ran. failed: the batch stopped at a failure. cancelled: interrupted. |
| `options` | yes | The options the batch ran with. |
| `totals` | yes | How many assets ended in each status. |
| `cache` | yes | Stage cache hits and misses over the batch. |
| `items` | yes | Samples rendered and restored from the render cache over the batch. |
| `assets` | yes | Each asset: status, time, error, warnings, outputs and cache use. |

## cli-envelope

JSON document printed to stdout with --json. Written to `stdout`. Schema: [schemas/cli-envelope.schema.json](../../schemas/cli-envelope.schema.json); see also [cli.md](cli.md).

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | yes | true on success; false when error is present. |
| `command` | yes | Command path such as "validate" or "asset show". |
| `version` | yes | td2d version. |
| `durationMs` | yes | How long the command took, in milliseconds. |
| `data` |  | Command-specific result. Present on success and, where useful, on failure. |
| `warnings` | yes | Warnings, also on success. Each has a code, a message and often a hint. |
| `error` |  | A structured error. |

## progress-event

NDJSON progress line printed to stderr with --json. Written to `stderr`. Schema: [schemas/progress-event.schema.json](../../schemas/progress-event.schema.json); see also [cli.md](cli.md).
